alternatives_rejected.why: CPU saturation would raise the service's own processing time, but own-span self-time p50 is unchanged at 0.14ms; only inbound, caller-observed latency rose (5.13->204.83ms), which fits network delay (E2).
The frontend's latency deviation is much smaller than currencyservice's (z=103 vs z=408), and frontend calls currencyservice, so its slowdown is consistent with propagation from currencyservice (E1).
Its p90 deviation (z=82) is smaller than currencyservice's, and checkout depends on currency conversion, so its slowdown is consistent with propagation from currencyservice (E1).

proposed_fix.description: Inspect and remove the network delay on the currencyservice pod's interface (e.g., tc netem rules or a faulty sidecar/network policy). If the cause cannot be found quickly, reschedule the pod to a healthy node. Then confirm inbound latency to currencyservice returns to about 5ms p50.
